players.name: Raleigh/Jeffers
players.summary: Ryan Jeffers diagnosed with hamate bone fracture on May 19, underwent surgery, out 6-8 weeks. Expected return around early July. Alex Jackson called up as backup.

sources.title: Ryan Jeffers To Miss 6-8 Weeks Recovering From Hamate Surgery

players.name: Bryce Harper
players.summary: Harper went 0-for-4 in PHI's 3-0 win at SDP. Healthy after a May 9 ocular migraine episode; Schwarber's MLB-leading 21st HR and Marsh's 2-run blast carried the Phillies.

sources.title: Phillies vs. Padres May 25 2026 Box Score

players.name: Luis Arraez
players.summary: Arraez went 1-for-4 (double) in SFG's 6-2 loss to ARI. Generating All-Star buzz — slashing .320 with elite defense (league-leading +8 OAA) at 2B, the Giants' brightest spot in a tough 2026.

sources.title: Giants still have a bright spot: All-Star candidate Luis Arraez

players.name: Bo Bichette
players.summary: Bichette went 3-for-4 (3 singles) in the Mets' 7-2 loss to CIN — his third multi-hit game in 9 contests, batting .308 in that stretch. A bright spot in an otherwise difficult season (.227 overall).

players.name: Lindor/McGonigle
players.summary: Detroit had a Memorial Day off day. Kevin McGonigle is healthy — slashing .312/.411/.481 on the season with his 8-year/$150M extension secured. One of the AL's top young shortstops.

players.name: Pete Crow-Armstrong
players.summary: PCA went 0-for-4 in Cubs' 1-2 loss at PIT, extending Chicago's 8-game skid. Slashing .197 in May (.225 overall); acknowledged he's 'trying too hard.' Moved to leadoff to kickstart his bat.

players.name: Jackson Merrill
players.summary: Merrill went 0-for-4 in SDP's shutout loss to PHI. Returned May 23 after back soreness from a wall collision (MRI/CT negative). Hitting just .217 on the season despite excellent defense.

sources.title: Jackson Merrill returns to Padres lineup after back injury

players.name: Teoscar Hernandez
players.summary: Hernandez blasted a 3-run HR in the 7th inning to ignite LAD's 4-run comeback rally in a 5-3 win vs COL. Scorching hot: .385 AVG, 3 HR, 15 RBI over the last 15 games.

players.name: Devin Williams
players.summary: Williams did not pitch in the Mets' 7-2 blowout loss; no save opportunity. After a rocky start to 2026, he has been resurgent with 10+ consecutive scoreless outings and 3 saves in that span.

players.name: Zack Wheeler
players.summary: Not Wheeler's day to pitch. He has been dominant in May: 1.38 ERA, 0.77 WHIP, 30:5 K:BB through 32.2 IP — five straight quality starts since returning from thoracic outlet decompression surgery.

players.name: Cole Ragans
players.summary: Ragans remains on the 15-day IL with left elbow impingement (VEO) since May 8. Completed a Triple-A rehab start; the Royals are optimistic about a return as soon as May 27 vs NYY.

sources.title: Royals Cole Ragans Set to Return From Elbow Injury

players.name: Chase Burns
players.summary: Burns starts May 26 vs the Mets. He carries a stellar 1.83 ERA through 10 starts — one of baseball's best young arms with a 28.2% strikeout rate and just 7.9% walk rate.

players.name: Nathan Eovaldi
players.summary: Not Eovaldi's scheduled start. The Rangers were no-hit 9-0 by Houston on May 25 (Rocker took the loss). Eovaldi has settled in with a 3.65 ERA through 11 starts after a tough opening stretch.

players.name: Emmet Sheehan
players.summary: Sheehan delivered 6 solid innings (5 H, 2 ER, 8 K) in LAD's 5-3 come-from-behind win vs COL. He was struck by a 103.8 mph comebacker in the 4th but stayed in. LAD rallied with 4 runs in the 7th; no decision for Sheehan.

sources.title: Colorado Rockies vs Los Angeles Dodgers recap May 25 2026

players.name: Reid Detmers
players.summary: Detmers pitched May 24 (not 25): career-high 14 K over 8 IP with 1 ER vs TEX, earning Box-Toppers Player of the Day. Did not earn the win (tied when he exited, LAA won walk-off). Next start ahead.

players.name: Stanton/Rice
players.summary: Ben Rice went 0-for-4 as NYY DH in the 4-3 walk-off win at KCR; Volpe's 9th-inning 2-run single was the winning blow. Rice leads the Yankees with 33 RBI and is having a breakout year (.282 AVG, 16 HR overall).

sources.title: Volpe hero as Yankees extend Royals dominance

injuries.name: Raleigh/Jeffers
injuries.note: Surgery completed; out 6-8 weeks, estimated return early July.

injuries.name: Cole Ragans
injuries.note: Left elbow VEO; Triple-A rehab start complete, targeting May 27 return vs NYY.

source.title: Royals Cole Ragans return from elbow IL

injuries.name: Jackson Merrill
injuries.note: Returned to lineup May 23; MRI/CT negative after wall collision attempting to rob Ohtani HR.

source.title: Jackson Merrill returns after back injury
